description: This is a simple, elegant table lamp with a conical lampshade and a decorative base. The lampshade is a clean white, likely made of fabric, and tapers slightly towards the top. It sits atop a slender stem that features a sculpted, bulbous detail, adding a touch of classic charm. The lamp is supported by a round, flat base, also in white. The overall design suggests a functional lighting solution that can also serve as a decorative element in a room. The clean lines and neutral color make it versatile for various interior design schemes.
